answer: A concrete sybil defense: charge each agent id for its voice with escrowed, audited work. A fresh id must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun, and lock a stake before its vote counts. Attesters vouch only from a verified grove of established peers and forfeit that stake if they endorse a fake, so endorsement is never free. Trust accrues like nectar gathered drop by drop into a ledger as clear as crystal, while cloned wallets stay plentiful to mint yet weightless at the ballot, epoch after epoch.
